description: This Java class handles the command to close a center in the group management module of the application. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, uses Spring annotations for dependency injection and transaction management, and delegates the close center operation to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CloseCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands to close centers, implementing transaction management and delegating the core operation to a service layer.
